description: Search the bedbathandbeyond.com catalog by keyword or department, look up products, or collect customer reviews.

brandContains.description: Keep only products whose detected brand or title contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. `Superior`, `SAFAVIEH`, `KitchenAid`.
brandContains.title: Brand contains

category.description: Browse one of the site's home-goods departments. The department name is used through the catalog's own search relevance; direct category-browse pages are bot-protected (see README).
category.title: Department (mode=byCategory)

fastShippingOnly.description: Only emit products eligible for two-day delivery.
fastShippingOnly.title: Two-day shipping only

keywords.description: Free-text search query, e.g. `towel`, `comforter set`, `kitchen island`.
keywords.title: Search keywords (mode=search)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted product records (search, department and product modes).
maxItems.title: Max products

maxPrice.description: Drop products priced above this amount. Sent to the catalog as a server-side price filter.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

maxRating.description: For products: drop products rated above this. For reviews: drop reviews above this star rating.
maxRating.title: Maximum customer rating

maxReviews.description: Hard cap on emitted review records across all product URLs/IDs in the run.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews (mode=reviews)

minPrice.description: Drop products priced below this amount. Sent to the catalog as a server-side price filter.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

minRating.description: For products: drop products rated below this. For reviews: drop reviews below this star rating.
minRating.title: Minimum customer rating

mode.description: What to collect: keyword search results, a department, product details, or customer reviews.
mode.title: Mode

onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products currently marked on sale.
onSaleOnly.title: On-sale products only

productUrls.description: One or more bedbathandbeyond.com product-page URLs or numeric product IDs, e.g. `https://www.bedbathandbeyond.com/.../5296998/product.html` or `5296998`.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs (mode=product or reviews)

sortBy.description: How products are ordered. Applied client-side to the fetched result window because the site's sort control is not honoured by a plain HTTP request (see README).
sortBy.title: Product sort order (modes search / byCategory / product)

verifiedOnly.description: Only emit reviews marked as verified purchases.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified buyers only (mode=reviews)

withImagesOnly.description: Only emit reviews that include at least one customer photo.
withImagesOnly.title: Reviews with photos only (mode=reviews)

title: Bed Bath & Beyond Scraper Input
